QF.id: SIA Case Studies on SAS Standards_69

question.text: Under SAS-1300 a common DEADWEIGHT scenario is:

answer.text: Participants who would have opened bank accounts anyway due to Jan Dhan / Nari Shakti schemes even without E-Diksha — the SIA must estimate this % and net out

explanation.text: The Logic: Jan Dhan's saturation coverage means a significant % of E-Diksha participants would have been brought into banking anyway. That is deadweight and SAS-1300 requires explicit estimation and subtraction. Options B, C, D are attrition / selection issues, not deadweight. The Trap: Option A captures deadweight correctly; the others are attrition. Cross-Exam Context: Deadweight cited in SROI Guide (UK Cabinet Office) and used across all SAS standards. Assessor's Pro-Tip: Use district-level Jan Dhan saturation as your deadweight floor. If Jan Dhan covers 80% of adults, claim at most 20% of account-opening outcomes to the SE.
